text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their skills begins once again this year.
However, some things were different from usual—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Everyo~ne, I have an announcement!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Normally, we grant permission for interviews
at the summer training camp if necessary...
but this year, please consider it almost completely off-limits!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, we have stationed more security guards than in previous years!
Not because anything happened, though, so please rest assured~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it's completely for Buena-chan's sake, isn't it?
Her popularity's been crazy lately, so...
It'd be bad if something happened to her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We really wanna focus during this important summer camp, after all~
Maybe this is pretty lucky for us too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...For my sake, huh.
choice_data_list: You don't need to be so humble, you know.
You don't need to be so humble, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Let's focus with all our might and grow by leaps and bounds!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Yeah, maybe I'll do just that!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that...
I can live up to everyone's expectations even more, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, thanks to the academy's consideration, we had
an environment where we could focus better—or so we thought.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"—Ah, it's like this every year, but...
this summer's heat is truly brutal—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that reporter...?
I'm pretty sure this year they're...?
choice_data_list: Let me check, so just hang on a sec.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did they get permission, or was it a miscommunication...?
Just as I was about to ask the reporter what happened—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Why, it's an absolute honor to be invited!
—Orfevre-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Appearing with majestic dignity was Orfevre...
Having conquered this year's Satsuki Sho and Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby),
she was an Umamusume standing just one step away from the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Naturally, it attracted massive buzz—every bit as much as Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"People are already saying the Classic Triple Crown is practically in the bag for you,
but how confident do you feel?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Reflect upon your actions immediately.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown will be mine. It is a foregone conclusion.
—Foolish questions will not be tolerated.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
M-Mercy...!
Forgive me...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...I have changed my mind.
I shall take my leave now—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hello, Orfe-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a bit late, but...
Congratulations on winning the Double Crown!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
At the Nippon Derby, blazing across
such a heavy, rain-soaked track with those incredible legs...
It was truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My late-stage burst
is far superior to yours.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First Nakayama Festa, and now Orfevre...
It feels like Buena Vista easily ends up
surrounded by girls with unique auras.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's true... I'd love to try it someday!
A battle of closing speed between me and Orfe-san♪
choice_data_list: (What makes Buena so incredible is that she never loses...)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh.
In that case, prepare the stage at once."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Your era is already coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —The golden dawn is near.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The next era, huh...
choice_data_list: ...Buena, don't let it get to you too much.
...Buena, don't worry about it too much.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: You're the strongest one currently running. There's no doubt about that.
You're the strongest still racing. There's no doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The strongest active racer...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're making me blush.
I hope I can really be like that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...All right!
Let's give it our all at summer training camp again this year!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu.
..."The strongest currently running," they say.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...You've really believed in me
this entire time, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's why all along,
I've also...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
Things can't stay the same forever.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I have to reach it.
Before the era changes—
